[2026 lineup / Dec 4-5 / Sixteen sessions]{.eyebrow}

Sixteen sessions across two days, all in the same room. Every one of them runs the same way: about 25 minutes of hands-on demonstration, 15 minutes of what and why, and 10 minutes of the room pushing back.

Filter by category below, or see the running order on the [schedule](../schedule.qmd).

::: {.note-panel}
A few details are still being confirmed with presenters, and the Saturday 4:00 slot is an ALERRT Center session with the topic to come. Presenters: send materials you want attendees to have to [sd33@txstate.edu](mailto:sd33@txstate.edu) and they will be linked from your session page.
:::
